Question: On the growth and development of a healthy child in the first year of life, which of the following statements is NOT true?

opc. The weight of a newborn can decrease 10% of the weight at birth during the first week.

ope. At one year of age, she is able to walk hand in hand, use the index-thumb clamp to pick up an object without help and deliver it to another person on request or gesture and use a few words in addition to "dad" and "mom".
